notes.title: Seventh Star achieves positive steam rating
notes.notes:
Seventh Star has achieved a positive steam rating!

Thank you everyone for your support -this game required so much effort to create so I'm so thankful it is being received so well by all of you.

I appreciate all of you that write me messages, post in the forums, and write reviews! This helps out so much!
I cannot stress enough how much all of this helps - especially considering I'm a solo developer.

Shane
Wolfs Moon Studios
